g.text: 1. Function: internal storage, Samsung KLMBG2JETD-B041 eMMC 5.1, 32 GB, 8-bit HS200 (BOM v1

g.desc: 1. Function: internal storage, Samsung KLMBG2JETD-B041 eMMC 5.1, 32 GB, 8-bit HS200 (BOM v1

g.text: line 10; BRD-037, BRD-043). Variant: production open between 16 and 32 GB; the 16 GB part

g.desc: line 10; BRD-037, BRD-043). Variant: production open between 16 and 32 GB; the 16 GB part

g.text: (KLMAG1JETD-B041, line 138) is a field override of this symbol, written from the variant files.

g.desc: (KLMAG1JETD-B041, line 138) is a field override of this symbol, written from the variant files.

g.text: 2. Absent state: not applicable (never omitted). With an empty eMMC the BootROM falls

g.desc: 2. Absent state: not applicable (never omitted). With an empty eMMC the BootROM falls

g.text: 3. EMMC_CLK: 22 Ω in series at the SoC; CMD and D0 10 kΩ pull-ups; a DS pull-down

g.desc: 3. EMMC_CLK: 22 Ω in series at the SoC; CMD and D0 10 kΩ pull-ups; a DS pull-down

g.text: (HDG 1.1 p. 26). The DS pull-down value (10 kΩ) is a capture choice: the HDG gives none.

g.desc: (HDG 1.1 p. 26). The DS pull-down value (10 kΩ) is a capture choice: the HDG gives none.

g.text: 4. VDDi: 2.2 µF (HDG 1.1 p. 26; CReg value not in the Samsung data sheet, UNVERIFIED).

g.desc: 4. VDDi: 2.2 µF (HDG 1.1 p. 26; CReg value not in the Samsung data sheet, UNVERIFIED).

g.text: 5. Links M (0.1 Ω full, 0 Ω production) on VCC and VCCQ (power tree §4.12 #14, #15).

g.desc: 5. Links M (0.1 Ω full, 0 Ω production) on VCC and VCCQ (power tree §4.12 #14, #15).

g.text: 6. Open: VCC and VCCQ decoupling at the eMMC (not in the data sheet, UNVERIFIED).

g.desc: 6. Open: VCC and VCCQ decoupling at the eMMC (not in the data sheet, UNVERIFIED).

g.text: RFU balls: 'do not use for any usage' (Samsung DS p. 5): no connection, as NC.

g.desc: RFU balls: 'do not use for any usage' (Samsung DS p. 5): no connection, as NC.

g.text: 7. Constraints: PCB-I-06 (EMMC_SD_50SE). The MaskROM pull on D0 belongs to blk.maskrom.

g.desc: 7. Constraints: PCB-I-06 (EMMC_SD_50SE). The MaskROM pull on D0 belongs to blk.maskrom.
